primary.title: Do you have to pay tax on your NRE deposit interest? Key rules NRIs should know
primary.summary: NRE accounts allow NRIs to deposit foreign income in Indian rupees, facilitating free repatriation. Interest on NRE fixed deposits is exempt from Indian income tax, enhancing their appeal.
